changeLog.change: Design approved for native adoption. All canonical features and prior matrices retained; native API/security/payment/physical controls must remain authoritative.

Ported the approved shared shell, customer/staff/field interfaces and focused forms. Retained all workflows and authority; added encrypted pending checkout recovery, exact payment-target binding and product-only server quotes. Cancellation remains a support request because customer direct cancellation is not an existing API privilege. All 300 leaves retained; current native device acceptance remains open.

Actual native phone guest Home/refill/delivery/area/calendar inspected with synthetic local API. Fixed canonical order navigation and customer-owned linked-appointment replay recovery. Implementation CI passed all1212 checks including previously local-skipped PostgreSQL cases; follow-up15 checks pass. Device Hub calendar controls currently unavailable to automation; remaining device checks retained.
